extension.summary: Sync your Silo movies and TV shows into the Kodi library
extension.description: KodiConnectForSilo writes the movies and TV shows on your Silo server into Kodi's own video library, so every skin, widget and library feature treats them like local media. Watched state and resume points stay in step both ways, and playback streams from Silo: the original file when Kodi can play it, a converted stream otherwise. Community project: not made or endorsed by the Silo team.
extension.disclaimer: Do not run Kodi's "Clean library" on Silo items; KodiConnectForSilo manages them itself.
extension.news:
0.19.0: Shuffle for a Silo collection, for Skyline's new collection page (an unwatched title first). Collection cards keep their backdrop past a day.
0.18.3: a film paused for a few minutes no longer stops and returns to Home when it resumes: the stream reconnects to Silo where it left off.
0.18.2: titles with a 1080p and a 4K copy, synced before 0.18.1, are labelled 4K once after updating (only those are rewritten). Episodes are labelled from their best copy too.
0.18.1: a title with several copies (1080p and 4K) plays the best one your TV shows; it played the first or last played copy, often 1080p.
0.18.0: asks once what your TV shows (highest resolution and HDR), starting on what Kodi detects. Until set, Silo sends 1080p SDR; its own quality setting doesn't apply to Kodi. Change it later in the add-on's settings, Playback.
0.17.2: turning the add-on off and on, or updating it, no longer leaves Silo's artwork port taken until Kodi restarts ("Port 57578 is in use"). The first update to 0.17.2 can still show it once: restart Kodi.
0.17.1: for Skyline's TV page: Back goes to the TV tab, as on the other pages, not into the preview's full screen.
0.17.0: Skyline's YouTube page is gone (the YouTube app does it better), with its background fetching, which had left a 2 GB SHIELD too little memory to start 4K. Skyline's TV page lists My teams last. Trailers still play through the YouTube add-on.
